subject: Cygnus: delegated deletion authority & tenant log TTL request
messages:

Cc: security@cygnus.health
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Data disposal delegation + tenant log TTL question

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for the demo last week — Cygnus is aligning on a couple of compliance items before we move to a pilot. Two asks from our security/compliance team:

1) Delegated deletion: we have regulated data scoped to specific tenants. Is there an option for Cygnus to request delegated deletion (i.e., allow our SOC team to initiate tenant-level removals via an authenticated API call) and receive an auditable trail that shows who requested deletion and when? If not, what is the recommended process for us to get timely deletion without opening support tickets?

2) Tenant log retention TTL: our auditors require 12 months of request/trace logs for tenants in scope for PCI. I saw the platform defaults to shorter retention in hosted. What are our options for 12-month retention for request logs and service-level audit logs for only a subset of tenants? Any cost/contract implications?

Can you share SOC 2 evidence and SIG responses relevant to retention/deletion? If there are forms we need to sign for exceptions, please attach.

Thanks — we need this info for our internal risk sign-off by July 6.

Best,
Jules Carter
Head of Security Engineering
Cygnus Health

Subject: Re: Data disposal delegation + tenant log TTL question

Hi Jules — thanks for the questions and the clear timeline. High level answers below; internal folks looped to pick up operational details.

1) Delegated deletion: We do not currently ship a self-serve delegated-deletion API for hosted accounts that grants write/delete access to customer-controlled identities. For Dedicated and Private deployments we support scoped API keys and customer-managed identity flows that can be used to implement delegated deletion with an auditable request ID. For hosted customers we can:
- Offer a managed exception where Cygnus is granted a documented deletion workflow (signed delegation form + SSO group mapping) and Redwood executes deletions via a support-run process that generates an audit bundle.
- Or we can accelerate building a limited delegated-delete API (security review required).

2) Tenant log TTL: Default hosted request and service audit logs are retained for 90 days. For 12-month retention we have two paths:
- Dedicated/Private: configurable retention windows per-tenant; supports 12 months natively (preferred for PCI-scoped workloads).
- Hosted exception: we can approve a 12-month retention for specific tenants via an exception; this requires a signed retention-exception form, updated contract terms for storage, and likely a delta in pricing to cover the storage and longer retention.

I've attached our SOC 2 report and a focused SIG worksheet that highlights answers on deletion/retention. Please review and let us know if you'd prefer Dedicated/Private for the pilot or want to move forward with an exception for hosted.

Next steps we recommend:
- Cygnus confirms which tenants need 12-month retention and whether you prefer Hosted-exception vs Dedicated.
- If Hosted-exception: sign the data-retention-exception form and the delegation-of-authority template; we will set a technical plan and cost estimate.
- If Dedicated: we'll loop Sales/Provisioning for capacity and SLA.

Thanks — cc'ing Dev for the technical plan and Mina for compliance attestations.

Regards,
Priyom Das
Senior Solutions Lead — Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-soc2-report-2026.pdf; sig-answers-cygnus.xlsx

Thanks Priyom — that helps. A couple follow-ups from our side before we pick a path:

- Hosted exception preferred in the short term due to timing and cost. Can you confirm you will provide an auditable deletion bundle that includes the requester identity (SAML/SSO id), deletion payload (tenant id and record scope), deletion job id, and post-deletion verification (confirmation that keys/data blobs removed)? Our compliance team requires this for their evidence.

- For the 12-month log TTL: we need written confirmation that logs for the scoped tenants will not be subject to background retention compaction or auto-purging for at least 12 months. An attestation PDF is helpful; if this requires contract language, we will put the exception in the contract addendum.

- Delegated deletion: if Hosted exception is supported, we still want a future-proof plan for a delegated-delete API. Can you share planned timeline or commitment level? If not, we need a Service Commitment (date window) for that capability.

Finally — if there are cost numbers for the hosted exception (monthly surcharge) please include them. Otherwise we will plan for Dedicated procurement.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Jules

Jules — appreciate the clarity. Proposed path and firm items below so you can take to your auditors.

1) Hosted exception (short-term):
- Scope: we will grant a hosted retention-exception for the specified tenants for 12 months. Exception will be documented via the attached data-retention-exception-form.pdf and signed by an authorized Cygnus signatory.
- Audit & deletion bundle: for any deletion executed under the exception we will provide an audit bundle containing:
  * Approver identity and timestamp (signed PDF of the approval email or DocuSign audit trail)
  * Requester identity (mapped SSO/SAML id or email)
  * Deletion payload (tenant id, top-level object keys, record counts)
  * Deletion job id and server-side logs showing action and completion status
  * Post-deletion verification hash (where applicable) or confirmation that data is out of reachable storage within the platform
- Retention guarantee: Redwood will not auto-purge the scoped tenant logs for the 12-month window; the exception is revocable with 30 days' notice for security reasons.
- Cost: hosted exception surcharge estimated at $0.50 per GB/month beyond baseline; final quote once we have estimated storage delta.

2) Delegated deletion API roadmap:
- Commitment: we will prioritize a limited delegated-delete API for hosted customers in our Q4 2026 roadmap subject to security review and SOC re-testing. We will share an RFC and expected timeline within two weeks. This is not a contractual SLA but a prioritized development commitment.

3) Longer-term: Dedicated/Private remains the recommended path for PCI-scoped workloads (native retention controls, customer-managed keys).

Next procedural steps for the hosted exception:
- Cygnus signs the attached data-retention-exception-form and the delegation-of-authority template.
- We will produce a technical runbook (Dev) and a compliance attestation (Mina) for your records.
- DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/embedded-sign/abc123 (included for convenience).

If this path works, I will prepare the formal exception package and loop Legal to include the addendum.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30-min call if you want to walk through the audit bundle fields.

Regards,
Priyom Das
Senior Solutions Lead — Redwood Inference
